##: Ximalaya live streaming assistant (喜马拉雅直播助手) for anchors, offered on ximalaya.com/download.

The page's 直播助手 Windows button points at .../down?from=live_win_002, which 302s twice (via .../down?from=live_pc) to the current object on nativedl.pcdn.xmcdn.com. That object URL carries the version in its filename and is what this manifest pins, so the recorded hash stays valid.
The download is a signed PE wrapper with an NSIS-3 installer appended; 7-Zip extracts it in one pass into $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z plus $R0\Uninstall 喜马拉雅直播助手.exe.
The payload is a 64-bit Electron app (only app-64.7z is shipped, there is no 32-bit build), with obs-studio-node and Zego streaming engines under resources\app.asar.unpacked.

build\libs\obs-studio-node\libobs-d3d11.dll imports msvcp140.dll/vcruntime140.dll and the installer ships VC_redist.x64.exe rather than the runtime itself, so the 2015-2022 redistributable is a declared dependency.

checkver.url points at robots.txt on purpose: the version comes from the script, which follows the redirect chain by hand and stops at the nativedl object, so the check never pulls the 241 MiB payload.
The vendor publishes no checksum, so autoupdate has no hash source and the Excavator recomputes the SHA-256 on update.
description: Live streaming assistant for Ximalaya anchors (喜马拉雅直播助手)
notes: The NSIS stubs ($PLUGINSDIR, $R0 with 'Uninstall 喜马拉雅直播助手.exe') are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.
User data and cache are written under %APPDATA%/%LOCALAPPDATA%, so nothing needs to be persisted.
Virtual camera and audio/video capture come from the bundled obs-studio-node and Zego engines; no system driver is registered by this package.
The bundled updater stays enabled and may update itself outside Scoop; run 'scoop install ximalaya-live -f' to return to the packaged build.
